aboutText: Ochre Plumbing & Gasfitting is a family-run plumbing and gasfitting business proudly serving Altona North and Melbourne's western suburbs. Led by Scott, we believe in honest pricing and genuine service — our customers regularly save thousands compared to big-name competitors. Whether it's emergency repairs, gas fitting, or hot water systems, we deliver reliable workmanship without the inflated quotes. We treat every Altona North home like our own.
servicesSubheading: Expert solutions for your home or business
servicesText: Ochre Plumbing & Gasfitting provides comprehensive plumbing and gasfitting services across Altona North and the western suburbs. From emergency leak repairs to full gas appliance installations, Scott and the team deliver quality workmanship at fair, upfront prices.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Fast response for burst pipes, blocked drains, and overflow emergencies across Altona North. We prioritise urgent jobs to get your home back to normal quickly.

services.title: Gas Fitting & Safety

services.title: Hot Water System Installation
services.desc: Expert installation and repair of gas and electric hot water systems. We'll recommend the right unit for your Altona North home and budget.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Sewer Clearing
services.desc: Professional drain clearing using modern equipment to fix blockages fast. We service all drainage systems for homes and businesses in Melbourne's west.

services.title: Leak Detection & Repair
services.desc: Advanced leak detection to find hidden water leaks without unnecessary damage. We fix taps, pipes, and fixtures efficiently and affordably.

services.desc: Complete plumbing for bathroom and kitchen renovations. From fixture replacement to full fit-outs, we handle all your Altona North plumbing needs.
